description: Mumbai's auto and cab drivers are learning Marathi due to a new state rule. Some drivers are using basic Marathi phrases to refuse passengers for various reasons. The government has established training centers and a helpline for drivers facing issues. Drivers failing tests receive a notice and a suspension period for language acquisition. Passengers hope for more ride acceptances and fewer excuses from drivers.
title: Mumbai auto drivers learn to refuse rides... in Marathi

author: YASHASVI VASISTHA
description: The US military conducted a strike on a boat in the Caribbean Sea. This operation resulted in the deaths of four individuals suspected of drug trafficking. Another strike in the eastern Pacific Ocean killed two people accused of similar activities. These recent attacks bring the total killed in such operations to at least 227. Human rights groups have criticized these actions as unlawful extrajudicial killings.
title: Watch: US military's 'lethal kinetic strike' destroys drug boat in Caribbean; 4 killed

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A Kentucky county closed its 225-acre Fox Run Golf Course after it averaged just 9,000 to 10,000 rounds annually. Now, the former golf property is being transformed into a major public park featuring trails, climbing areas, biking facilities, water features and family spaces. Around 70% of the site will remain preserved as natural greenspace for future generations.
title: Kentucky county turns 225-acre golf course into major public park, 70% stays green

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Eddie Owens Martin, an innovative and unconventional artist, dedicated nearly three decades to transforming his land in Georgia into the vibrant, visionary art space known as Pasaquan. He intricately combined various cultural elements through his painted totems and impressive masonry. After years of exposure and deterioration, the Kohler Foundation intervened with a major restoration, breathing new life into this unique site.
title: Pasaquan: How a Georgia artist spent 29 years building a 900-foot visionary art world

author: PARTHA SINHA
description: One explanation identified by the study is that strong profitability from assets companies already own does not necessarily make a new investment equally attractive. Its analysis found evidence that the initial returns associated with fresh fixed-asset investment have weakened in the post-pandemic period, putting downward pressure on what the paper calls “marginal profitability”.
title: Post-Covid, profits rise faster than investment

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: German immigrant Max Schlemmer introduced rabbits to Laysan Island in 1903 for business and entertainment.  These rabbits rapidly consumed vegetation, leading to the extinction of three unique landbird species.  President Theodore Roosevelt established the Hawaiian Islands Bird Reservation to protect the remaining wildlife.  Federal authorities later removed Schlemmer and eradicated the invasive rabbit population by 1923.  Conservationists have since worked to restore the habitat and reintroduce species to the island.
title: 1903 Laysan Island rabbit release stripped island bare, drove 3 bird species extinct

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In 1914, homesteader Benjamin Loomis captured the dramatic eruptions of Lassen Peak through his photography. Along with his wife, Estella, he later established a museum and seismograph station on their land. This rich historical site was formally donated to the United States in 1929 and is now recognized as the Loomis Museum, serving to inform and engage visitors about the fascinating history of volcanic activity.
title: 1929 gift gave Lassen Park its first private museum, 40 acres and a seismograph

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Dolly Parton has passed away at the age of eighty, as confirmed by her family. A recent video showing her humorously discussing Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift's potential child now carries a bittersweet weight. The beloved country singer had expressed gratitude to the duo for a generous contribution to her Imagination Library, a program dedicated to providing books for children and a cornerstone of her legacy.
title: Dolly Parton’s final message to Travis Kelce is breaking hearts after her death

author: SACHIN PARASHAR
title: India & China welcome border peace, Beijing seeks 'package solution'

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Bill Belichick says he feels confident taking over defensive play calling if North Carolina needs him while Steve Belichick remains on medical leave. Bill has not confirmed that he will call the defense against TCU. Steve’s return date is still unknown. UNC opens its season in Dublin on August 29, leaving the Tar Heels with an important coaching decision.
title: Bill Belichick addresses son Steve’s UNC absence amid defensive play-calling call
